tools.name: count_businesses
tools.description: Count verified B2B businesses in the LeadQuasar database matching an industry, country, US state and/or city, with how many have an email address and a phone number. Use this to answer questions like 'how many managed service providers are there in Texas', 'how many dentists in Chicago have a busine

tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Return a sample of matching businesses with industry, location and data-quality signals. Contact details (name, company, email, phone, address) are never returned by this tool — it shows what exists and how reachable it is, not who to call.

tools.name: search_volume
tools.description: How many people search Google each month for a keyword in a city, region or country, as a range such as 1K–10K (via LeadQuasar KeywordQuasar), with up to 5 related searches and their ranges and about how many matching businesses LeadQuasar holds there. Exact figures are on LeadQuasar's Plus and Max

tools.name: list_industries
tools.description: List the industries LeadQuasar covers and how many verified businesses each holds. Use this first when unsure what industry wording will match.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_businesses · Private data: count_businesses, search_businesses, search_volume · Public sink: count_businesses, search_businesses.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_businesses · Private data: count_businesses, search_businesses, search_volume · Public sink: count_businesses, search_businesses

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "count_businesses" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
